facts.text: Serve the snacks when Bastian unwraps his lunch in the school attic.
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot has Bastian arriving late and hiding in the school attic to read, with no lunch or eating mentioned there, and the transcript has no lunch or attic meal.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Bastian hides in the school attic to read.

facts.text: Atreyu, I've got my apple and a cheese sandwich up here in the attic. I'm reading all night.
facts.why: Note signed Bastian. The attic and reading through the night fit the plot, but the apple and cheese sandwich are not in any source opened, and Bastian never talks to Atreyu in the film. Could not verify.
facts.fix: Atreyu, I've got the book and the whole night in this attic. Keep going, I'm not stopping.

fix_note.text: Atreyu, I've got the book and the whole night in this attic. Keep going, I'm not stopping.

facts.text: Gmork is waiting in the cave. Eat fast.
facts.why: Gmork closes in on Atreyu and then waits for him in the ancient ruins, where Atreyu finds murals of his journey. It is not a cave.
facts.fix: Gmork is waiting in the ruins. Eat fast.

vibe.verdict: A cosy recipe box with the right Fantasia names, but it never goes near Morla, the Oracle's sphinxes or Gmork, and the home layout feels more kitchen than attic.
